assumptions.carrier: integral genus-one normalization carrier C in |lP|

local_lemma.statement: On a smooth surface, if C is an integral Cartier curve and D is smooth with I_p(C,D)=1, then C is smooth at p.
local_lemma.proof_key: In regular parameters with D=(x), length O/(x,f)=1 forces f mod x to have a nonzero linear term, hence f notin m^2 and mult_p(C)=1.
